questions.question: ________ is the lowest point of India, lying at an elevation of 2.2 m below the sea level.
questions.solution: __ • **The lowest point in India is located at Kuttanad. **__ • The lowest point in India lies at 2.2 meters below the sea level. • Kuttanad, the 'Rice Bowl of Kerala’, lies at the very heart of the backwaters in Alappuzha district of Kerala. • The Kuttanad Below Sea-level Farming System (KBSFS) is unique, as it is the only system in India that practices rice cultivation below sea level.

questions.question: Who established the Mughal Empire in India in 1526?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Babur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Babur** was the **first** Mughal emperor and **founder** of the **Mughal empire** in India in 1526.
 
• The** First Battle of Panipat** was fought between Babur and Lodhi dynasty in the year **1526.** This battle established the Mughal rule in India for the first time.
 
• In 1526, the Mughal forces of Babur, the Timurid ruler of Kabulistan, defeated the much larger ruling army of Ibrahim Lodi,Sultan of Delhi. The battle was fought on 21 April near the small village of Panipat, in the present day Indian state of Haryana, an area that has been the site of a number of decisive battles for the control of Northern India since the twelfth century.
 
• Zahiruddin Muhammad Babur descended on his father’s side from the Turkish conqueror Timur.
 
• **Humayun** was the second emperor of the Mughal Empire. He was the son of Babur. He became the Mughal emperor at the age of 23.
 
• **Akbar**- The Full Name of Akbar was Abu'l-Fath Jalal-ud-din Muhammad Akbar. He was the third emperor of the Mughal empire. He was the son of Humayun.
 
• **Shahjahan**- The full name of Shahjahan was A'la Azad Abul Muzaffar Shahab ud-Din Mohammad Shah Jahan. He is the fifth emperor of the Mughal empire.

questions.question: Which one among the following is a deficiency disease?
